name: DeltaNet
tagline: Correct matrix memory using the current prediction error.
description: The previous state predicts the current value, then the key and write strength β update the memory. Unlike simple KV accumulation, the delta rule can correct information already stored in the state.
paperTitle: Parallelizing Linear Transformers with the Delta Rule over Sequence Length
mechanism: S ← S + k[β(v − kᵀS)]ᵀ, followed by output qᵀS
Causal convolution of width 4, SiLU, Q/K L2 normalization and sigmoid β
FP32 state, reset at packed-row boundaries
limitations: A token-by-token mathematical scan is not an efficient chunked training kernel. A generation cache is not provided. The completed run uses a separately frozen FLA fused-recurrent backend and an operator-level cost ledger with backward replay; see its evidence and source patch. It does not establish a fused backend in the current code.
